predictions: 6/8 fire above 0.4; name pairs from music, comedy or sport with the same 'and' stay below 0.1.
notes: Probes: 'Watson and Crick' 0.917, 'Avery, MacLeod' 0.842, 'his partner Francis Crick' 0.501, but also Jack Welch 0.653 and a DNA sentence without names 0.355; Lennon and McCartney 0.009. The distinction tested is a science credit versus a non-science name pair.
